Privacy Policy

Effective Date: October 2026 • Applies across TRTT VoyageHub, FlightScoutPro, and affiliated web properties.

1. Introduction & Scope

TRTT VoyageHub (trttnews24bd.blogspot.com) and its partner publication FlightScoutPro (flightscoutpro.blogspot.com) are dedicated to maintaining the highest privacy and data integrity standards in accordance with the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation EU 2016/679) and global privacy conventions.

2. Data We Do NOT Collect

We adhere strictly to data minimization principles. We do NOT harvest, sell, or trade sensitive personal information, payment card credentials, national ID numbers, or private user passwords. Direct booking transactions are handled exclusively on the encrypted, PCI-DSS compliant servers of our authorized partners.

3. Cookies, Analytics & Affiliate Tracking (Marker 787950)

When you interact with our travel comparison widgets or follow links to our verified partners (Aviasales, AirHelp, Airalo, Kiwitaxi, Amazon), a standard HTTP referral cookie containing our affiliate tracking parameter (Marker: 787950) may be stored by the destination website. This allows our partners to record qualifying bookings and attribute referral commissions at no additional cost to you.

4. Your Rights Under EU GDPR

Under European data protection laws, you possess the right to access, rectify, or request erasure of any personal communication or data provided to our editorial bureau. You may exercise these rights at any time by contacting our designated privacy representatives.
